profile.intro: I’m Yongky, founder of Turudev Tech and a full-stack developer in Jakarta. A vibecoder who keeps the engineering: I direct Claude Code and Codex to build, then review, test and fix everything they produce before it reaches production.
profile.statement: Vibecoding, with the engineering kept in. I don’t just prompt and hope. I write the PRD, direct Claude Code and Codex, then review, test and fix every line until it holds up in production. Four internal products, two live apps and a Roblox game later, that is still the job.

answers.text: Empuan is a women’s health, safety and education app Yongky launched under Turudev Tech: a Flutter app on a Laravel API with an AI health assistant on Google Gemini, period tracking, Emergency SOS, a community and certified courses. It is live at empuanapp.id.
Qi-R is a live QR-code and short-link SaaS at qi-r.me, built at PT Hantam Kreasi Utama with AI coding tools. Its analytics separate unique, valid and repeat visits with 30-minute deduplication.

Warteg Sultan! is a 6-player Roblox tycoon in development at v0.5. Yongky directs Claude Code from versioned PRDs, and Claude builds scenery and NPCs in Studio through the Roblox Studio MCP. It has 142 passing unit tests.
He holds a Bachelor of Information Systems from BINUS University (2021–2025) with a GPA of 3.84 out of 4.00.
Yongky founded Turudev Tech in 2024, an AI software studio building AI assistants, workflow automation and data tools.
Since February 2025 he has been Junior IT Staff at PT Hantam Kreasi Utama, where he shipped 4 internal products end to end with Claude Code and Codex.

Claude Code, Codex and MCP for building; TypeScript, React, Next.js, NestJS, Laravel and Flutter for the product; PostgreSQL, Redis and Prisma for data; Docker, Proxmox, Nginx and WireGuard to run it.

Yongky calls himself a vibecoder, with the engineering kept in: he writes the PRD, directs Claude Code and Codex to build, then reviews, tests and fixes everything himself before it ships. The AI writes fast; he answers for what reaches production.
He turns requirements into a PRD, directs Claude Code and Codex to build against it, then reviews, tests and fixes the output before deploying to Linux servers.
Yes, he is open to select projects. Email yongkyanthony23@gmail.com or find him on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/yongky-anthonychow.

Two live products (Empuan and Qi-R), four internal products at PT Hantam Kreasi Utama, client platforms such as Batiqiyan and the Desa Mangunkerta portal, plus a Roblox game, a monitoring bot and a self-hosted homelab.
